notes:
New in 0.1.3.7 - Performance mode for laptops:
- New setting: Esc > Simulation quality > "Performance". The water runs at half resolution (each water grain is 2x2 pixels), about 4-5x faster. Waves and gameplay behave the same, the edge and foam are a bit chunkier. Changing it restarts the level.
- If the water is too heavy for the PC, the game now suggests Performance mode after about 10 seconds.
- Bug reports: the game now says on screen whether a report was sent or failed.
- Bug reports: if the secure connection to GitHub is refused, the game retries with the certificates Windows trusts (fix for the laptop uploads).

On the laptop: Esc > Simulation quality > Performance, then play. Press F12 once to check that reports now arrive.
